items.title: PIC completes £85m buy-in for Interface Europe Pension Scheme
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that Pension Insurance Corporation has completed an £85 million buy-in covering over a thousand members of the Interface Europe Pension Scheme.

items.title: Commonwealth University Introduces Risk Management and Insurance Curriculum
items.summary: Insurance Journal reports that Pennsylvania’s Commonwealth University has launched new academic offerings in risk management and insurance.

items.title: Salon Owners Urge Budget VAT Cut Amid Rising Employment Pressures
items.summary: BBC reports that over 2,000 hair and beauty business owners have signed an open letter calling on the Chancellor to lower VAT from 20% to 10%.

items.title: K2 Insurance Services to close Aegis General's Executive Risks Division
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that K2 Insurance Services is shutting down the Executive Risks Division of its subsidiary, Aegis General Insurance Agency, following a portfolio review.

items.title: Gallagher Expands Texas Employee Benefits Operations via Mund Group Deal
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. has acquired Texas-based employee benefits agency Mund Group, Ltd.

items.title: APAC cedents seeking holistic solutions beyond pure volatility cover, says Marsh Re's Tony Gallagher
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that insurance cedents across the Asia Pacific region are increasingly looking for holistic solutions and earnings protection amid frequent secondary catastrophe perils, according to Marsh Re's Tony Gallagher.
